# netbox_users (Data Source)

Retrieves all users from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_users" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "date_joined"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "users_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_users.example.users[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `users` (Attributes List) The users found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `date_joined` (String) The date joined of the users.
- `email` (String) The email of the users.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the users.
- `groups` (List of Number) The IDs of the groups of the users.
- `id` (Number) The id of the users.
- `is_active` (Boolean) The is active of the users.
- `last_login` (String) The last login of the users.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the users.
- `permissions` (List of Number) The IDs of the permissions of the users.
- `username` (String) The username of the users.
